result.summary: Found 2 issues: one content issue with a typo in the search bar placeholder, and one layout issue with the third restaurant card being clipped.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is missing the letter 'u' (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is visibly clipped — both the card image and the restaurant name are cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visual affordance indicating it is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: While partial clipping can hint at scrollability, ensure the card is clipped consistently and intentionally (e.g., always show ~20–30% of the next card). Also consider adding a subtle scroll indicator or shadow to make the horizontal scrolling behavior more discoverable.
